## What changes for users?

Describe the concrete problem and resulting behavior.

## Evidence

List checks actually executed and their results. For visual changes, include genuine desktop/mobile screenshots, matching state and source provenance. Separate scripted examples from native agent runs; leave unrun checks explicit.

## Review notes

Mention preservation risks, dependencies, known limitations and any incomplete work. Keep credentials, personal details, private transcripts and review keys out of this PR.
